item.beepsresourcegenerators.tuning_fork: This crystal isn't linked to a resonator yet
beepsresourcegenerators.ponder.resonator: The Resonator interacts with nearby crystals
A single crystal can only correctly resonate with one Resonator
Adding a second Resonator nearby creates dissonance
Multiple crystals can be used within the same Resonator
A Tuning Fork can be used to show the Resonator's range
A Resonator is vulnerable to interference
For example, rain near its operating area will reduce the chance of success
It's best to keep your Resonator free from distractions
Modulators are special blocks that modify how the Resonator interacts with nearby crystals
They can be placed as part of your crystal arrangement
Some Modulators have an area of effect, and others affect the entire system
beepsresourcegenerators.ponder.modulator: The Silk Touch Modulator allows you to obtain ore blocks instead of raw ore
The Silk Touch Modulator affects all crystals directly surrounding it
Fortune Modulators apply the Fortune enchantment on the crystal whenever it generates resources
The Fortune Modulator operates on a 5x5 plus
Multiple Fortune Modulators can affect one crystal
A Silk Touch Modulator disables the effects of any Fortune Modulators
The Auto-Smelt Modulator affects any crystals that sit between it and the Resonator
Any crystal that does not intersect an Auto-Smelt Modulator does not get affected
beepsresourcegenerators.ponder.tag.creat: Forming blank crystals and infusing them with a resource
beepsresourcegenerators.ponder.tag.using: Resonators, and the Modulators that shape what they produce
beepsresourcegenerators.ponder.crystal_b: Blank Crystals can be created using the Crystal Former
There are %s different types of Blank Crystal you can form
The blank crystal determines how likely the crystal is to resonate
beepsresourcegenerators.ponder.crystal_i: A Blank crystal doesn't do anything on its own, it needs to be infused
Many materials can be infused into crystals
You cannot infuse a crystal with multiple materials
